quest.title: The Special Support Squad's Tale
quest.description: Listen to the ghosts' whispers and retrieve their names.

dialogues.speaker: Lost Phantom
dialogues.text: As per the emergency plan, if the warning signal goes off, HQ will send us, the special support squad "Sumrak," to reinforce them.

dialogues.speaker: Lost Phantom
dialogues.text: The fog here is too thick. We can't see the lighthouse.

dialogues.speaker: Lost Phantom
dialogues.text: Are you a Lightkeeper stationed on this island... please respond...

response.speaker: Lost Phantom
response.text: As per the emergency plan, if the warning signal goes off, HQ will send us, the special support squad "Sumrak," to reinforce them.

response.speaker: Lost Phantom
response.text: The fog here is too thick. We can't see the lighthouse...

response.speaker: Lost Phantom
response.text: Can't see... can't see... can't see...

choices.text: The lighthouse is to the northeast.

dialogues.speaker: Lost Phantom
dialogues.text: We weren't able to find any survivors, only shrieking monsters and bodies. What do we do? Where should we go?

dialogues.speaker: Lost Phantom
dialogues.text: We can only follow the lighthouse's guidance... but is there anyone else who can show us the way?
